word: I dropped out of Reed College after the first six months, but then stayed around as a drop-in for another 18 months or so before I really quit.
meaning: 我在里德學院讀了六個月後就辦理退學，但此後還以旁聽生的身份待了大約十八個月，才算真正離開。
example: He left school officially but kept attending classes informally for over a year before truly quitting.
hint:
中文解釋：說明退學的過程——形式上退學，但仍以旁聽方式留在校園一段時間。
1) drop out (v.): 退學；syn: quit school; ant: graduate
2) drop-in (n.): 旁聽生，非正式出席者；syn: informal attendee; ant: enrolled student
pronunciation: Chunks: I DROPPED OUT | of REED COL-lege | af-ter the FIRST SIX MONTHS. Stress: EIGH-TEEN MONTHS | be-fore I REAL-ly QUIT.

meaning: 那麼，我為什麼要退學呢？
example: He pauses and asks the question that everyone is wondering about.
hint:
中文解釋：以反問方式勾起聽眾好奇心，帶出後面的故事。
1) why'd (contr.): why did 的縮寫口語形式；syn: for what reason; ant: (n/a)
2) drop out (v.): 退學、中輟；syn: quit; ant: stay enrolled
pronunciation: Rising tone: So WHY'D I drop out? (emphatic question, slight upward pitch)

word: It started before I was born.
meaning: 這要從我出生之前說起。
example: The real story of why he dropped out began even before his birth.
hint:
中文解釋：出乎意料的故事起點——比想像中更早，吸引聽眾專注。
1) started (v.): 開始；syn: began; ant: ended
2) before I was born (phr.): 在我出生之前；syn: prior to my birth; ant: after my birth
pronunciation: Dramatic, slow: It START-ed | BE-fore I was BORN. (deliberate pause after 'started')

word: My biological mother was a young, unwed graduate student, and she decided to put me up for adoption.
meaning: 我的親生母親是一位年輕、未婚的研究生，她決定將我送人收養。
example: His birth mother was a young unmarried student who chose to give him up for adoption.
hint:
中文解釋：交代親生母親的背景，以及她做出的艱難決定。
1) biological mother (n.): 親生母親；syn: birth mother; ant: adoptive mother
2) put up for adoption (phr.): 將孩子送養；syn: give up for adoption; ant: keep the child
pronunciation: Key words: bi-o-LOG-i-cal | un-WED | put me UP for a-DOP-tion. Pause after 'student'.

word: She felt very strongly that I should be adopted by college graduates, so everything was all set for me to be adopted at birth by a lawyer and his wife.
meaning: 她非常堅持我必須被大學畢業生收養，所以一切都已安排好，讓我在出生時由一位律師和他的妻子領養。
example: She insisted that only college graduates could adopt him, and a lawyer couple was already prepared.
hint:
中文解釋：親生母親對收養家庭有明確要求，並且已找到合適人選，一切就緒。
1) felt strongly (phr.): 強烈堅持；syn: insisted; ant: felt indifferent
2) all set (adj.): 一切就緒，準備好了；syn: ready; ant: unprepared
pronunciation: Emphasis: FELT ver-y STRONG-ly | ALL SET | at BIRTH | by a LAW-yer and his WIFE.

word: Except that when I popped out, they decided at the last minute that they really wanted a girl.
meaning: 但就在我出生的那一刻，那對夫妻卻在最後關頭決定，他們其實想要一個女孩。
example: At the very last moment, the couple changed their mind and wanted a daughter instead.
hint:
中文解釋：原本安排好的收養計畫因為性別而突然生變，語氣帶點幽默與無奈。
1) popped out (phr.): 出生（口語活潑說法）；syn: was born; ant: (n/a)
2) at the last minute (phr.): 在最後關頭；syn: at the very end; ant: in advance
pronunciation: Casual: when I POPPED OUT | at the LAST MIN-ute | really WANT-ed a GIRL. (light, slightly ironic)

word: So my parents, who were on a waiting list, got a call in the middle of the night asking, 'We've got an unexpected baby boy. Do you want him?'
meaning: 於是，排在等待名單上的我的父母，在半夜接到一通電話，問說：「我們這裡有個意料之外的小男孩，你們要嗎？」
example: His parents received a surprising late-night phone call offering them an unexpected baby boy.
hint:
中文解釋：意外的轉折——Jobs 的養父母因為在等候名單上，意外獲得了這個機會。
1) waiting list (n.): 等候名單；syn: queue; ant: immediate placement
2) unexpected (adj.): 出乎意料的；syn: surprising; ant: expected
pronunciation: Narrative build: in the MID-dle of the NIGHT | UN-ex-pect-ed BA-by BOY | Do you WANT him? (rising on 'want')

example: His parents immediately and warmly agreed to take the baby.
hint:
中文解釋：簡短有力的回應，展現養父母毫不猶豫的愛與接納。
1) of course (phr.): 當然，毫無疑問；syn: absolutely; ant: no
2) they said (phr.): 他們回答；syn: they responded; ant: they refused
pronunciation: Warm + instant: They said... 'Of COURSE.' (brief pause before 'Of course', warm rising tone)
